jobs.description:
Project Owner / Service Delivery Operations Lead

Finance & Accounting Operations | AP, AR, Invoice Processing, Procurement Support, Reconciliations, F&A Back Office

Role positioning :-
This is a client-facing service delivery role for Finance & Accounting operations. ARDEM is hiring an operational owner who can run AP/AR, invoice, procurement, reconciliation, and recurring finance workflows with production control, client communication, SLA/TAT discipline, quality ownership, and team leadership.

Position Summary

ARDEM is seeking a Project Owner / Service Delivery Operations Lead for Finance & Accounting Operations. This role owns the daily delivery and client-facing operational management of assigned finance and accounting workflows.
The right candidate understands finance operations enough to manage delivery quality, exceptions, controls, workflow handoffs, client expectations, SLA/TAT, backlog, and team execution. This person does not need to be the sales SME or proposal owner, but must be credible with client finance teams and strong enough to own the delivery operation after handoff.

Core Responsibilities

Responsible for 100% accuracy, 100% on time delivery and meeting customer TAT requirements
Responsible for 100% customer satisfaction
Responsible for delivery results and the management of 10 customer orders and 50 team members.
Maintain process control through project management documentation, including but not limited to work instructions, process maps, exception rules, quality checklists, training notes, issue logs, change logs, and ownership of the latest approved process version.
Become the subject matter expert for assigned projects. You are the Technical and Process for your customer orders.
Own daily production control for assigned client workflows, including incoming volume, completed work, backlog, aging, SLA/TAT risk, blockers, staffing capacity, urgent client requests, and next-24-hour priorities.
Lead the delivery team by assigning work, clarifying priorities, monitoring output, coaching performance, addressing attendance/capacity issues, and ensuring analysts understand expectations.
Communicate directly with clients through delivery calls, status updates, escalation of communication, actionitem recaps, and proactive risk notifications.
Run weekly governance for assigned accounts: output, SLA/timeliness, quality, backlog/aging, open issues, client dependencies, staffing/coverage, risks, corrective actions, and next steps.
Maintain process control through current work instructions, process maps, exception rules, quality checklists, training checklists, issue logs, change logs, and processing logs.
Identify delivery, quality, staffing, access, documentation, client dependency, scope, backlog, and trust risks early; escalate with facts, impact, timeline, recommendations, and required support.
Drive continuous improvement by identifying repeat issues, root causes, rework patterns, process waste, training gaps, and opportunities to improve accuracy, speed, visibility, and client experience.
Responsible for customer project success and delivery ownership starting from the time of internal handoff from sales and lasting through the end of customer project assignment.

Ideal Candidate Profile

5-10 years in F&A BPO/BPM, shared services, finance operations, AP/AR operations, procurement operations, accounting operations, or managed finance and accounting back-office operations.
At least 05 years' experience as Assistant Manager - F&A Operations, Team Lead - AP/AR, Process Lead - Finance Operations, Service Delivery Lead - Finance Operations, or Operations Lead - Shared Services.
Has managed real production work: invoice volumes, AP/AR queues, exception handling, aging, SLA/TAT, quality checks, team output, staffing, and client escalations.
Strong English communication with direct client-facing experience. Must be able to lead calls, explain delivery status, communicate risk, and create confidence with client finance stakeholders.
Ability to receive and act on client feedback in a professional and expedient manner.
Understands process control, internal controls, approvals, documentation, audit trails, quality review, and exception management.
Capable of working independently in a high-ownership environment, where waiting for “someone to tell you what to do “is not acceptable.

Must-Have Capabilities

Production command: knows current work status, volume, backlog, aging, exceptions, staffing, and SLA risk.
Client-facing confidence: can speak clearly with finance stakeholders and manage delivery expectations.
Quality discipline: understands how finance errors happen, how to catch them, and how to prevent recurrence.
Ownership mindset: acts before the client complains and escalates risk early with facts and recommendations.
Documentation discipline: keeps SOPs, exception rules, quality checklists, change logs, and training notes current.

Red Flags

Only performed AP/AR work as an individual contributor but never managed production, team output, or client delivery.
Strong accounting knowledge but weak operations management and client communication.
Talks only about task completion, not SLA, backlog, aging, quality trends, risk, or corrective action.
Cannot explain how they handle repeated errors, client escalations, late approvals, or exception-heavy workflows.
Acts like a finance analyst instead of a delivery owner.

ERP and Process Automation

Lead implementation, configuration, and optimization of ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Sage, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar).
Create and maintain master data, workflows, and reporting dashboards within ERP platforms.
Collaborate with technical teams to automate recurring accounting and reporting tasks.
Generate and analyse ERP-based reports for financial insights, KPIs, and performance reviews.
Train team members on ERP navigation, reporting tools, and compliance practices.

Technical Requirements

System: Windows laptop/desktop (Intel i5 or higher, minimum 8GB RAM).
Screen: Minimum 14 inches, Full HD (19201080 resolution).
Internet: High-speed broadband connection (100 Mbps or higher).
Software: AnyDesk for remote connectivity

Development quality: Deliver at least 95% of site surveys, feasibility studies, and investment-grade cost estimates by the committed deadline, with less than 5% requiring material rework due to engineering errors or omissions.

Direct feasibility studies and technical evaluations for HVAC, central plant, utility modernization, and energy efficiency projects.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Financial Operations Analyst is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely reconciliation of financial transactions with commercial partners, including digital wallets, banks and other distribution channels such as GCash, Maya, AUB, and similar partners. The role will manage end-to-end partner reconciliations covering revenue sharing, platform fees, commissions, transaction settlements, receivables, payables, and dispute resolution.

This position serves as a key control function within Finance and Operations, ensuring financial accuracy, completeness of partner settlements, and timely identification and resolution of discrepancies.

RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES

Partner Reconciliation & Settlement

Perform daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations of financial transactions with external strategic partners.
Validate revenue-sharing computations, commissions, platform fees, settlement amounts, and partner invoices against contractual agreements and supporting records.
Reconcile partner transaction reports against internal systems, accounting records, and actual bank settlements.
Investigate, resolve, and document reconciliation variances, exceptions, and unmatched transactions in a timely manner.
Ensure the timely and accurate processing of partner settlements, collections, and related financial transactions.
Prepare and issue manual official receipts or other applicable collection documents, as necessary, in accordance with Company policies and regulatory requirements.
Maintain complete and accurate reconciliation schedules, supporting documents, and settlement records for audit and reporting purposes.

Revenue Share Management

Compute, review, and validate revenue-sharing arrangements (i.e. Profit Sharing Computation) in accordance with approved contractual agreements and commercial terms.
Monitor partner earnings, commissions, rebates, incentives, platform fees, and other applicable revenue-sharing arrangements.
Ensure the accurate computation, accrual, and recognition of partner-related revenues and expenses in coordination with the Finance Team.
Review and reconcile revenue-sharing computations against actual transactions, contractual provisions, and accounting records.
Coordinate with Finance, Growth, and other relevant business teams to resolve revenue-sharing discrepancies and process necessary adjustments.
Maintain supporting schedules and documentation for revenue-sharing computations and settlements.

Premiums Receivable, Accounts Receivable & Accounts Payable Monitoring

Monitor partner-related premium receivables and other outstanding balances to ensure timely collection and settlement.
Track partner payables and ensure payments are processed accurately and within agreed contractual terms.
Prepare and maintain receivables and payables aging reports, including regular follow-ups on overdue balances and unresolved items.
Ensure that receivables and payables subsidiary schedules and aging reports are reconciled with the General Ledger balances upon completion of the monthly closing.
Prepare and endorse the necessary journal entries for adjustments arising from partner reconciliations, subject to review and approval by the appropriate Finance personnel.
Investigate and resolve long-outstanding balances, unidentified collections, and other reconciling items.
Assist in cash flow forecasting by providing expected collections, partner settlement obligations, and other relevant financial information.
Ensure the timely submission of reconciliation schedules and supporting reports in accordance with the Finance month-end closing timetable.

Financial Controls & Risk Management

Establish, implement, and maintain effective reconciliation controls, procedures, and documentation standards.
Identify reconciliation gaps, process inefficiencies, control weaknesses, and potential financial risks, and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
Ensure compliance with internal control requirements, accounting policies, approved procedures, and contractual obligations with external partners.
Maintain proper audit trails and supporting documentation for all reconciliation activities, adjustments, and settlements.
Monitor and escalate significant reconciliation discrepancies, overdue balances, and unresolved financial exposures to Finance Management.
Support internal and external audit requirements by preparing reconciliation schedules, financial analyses, and supporting documentation.
Assist in the implementation of process improvements and automation initiatives to strengthen reconciliation accuracy, efficiency, and controls.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Finance, Operations, Product, Technology, Growth, and Partner Management teams to ensure accurate and timely reconciliation of partner transactions.
Coordinate directly with external partners to investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies, settlement issues, and financial disputes.
Facilitate alignment among relevant teams on transaction reporting, data requirements, reconciliation methodologies, and settlement processes.
Support the implementation of new products, distribution channels, and strategic partner integrations by ensuring that appropriate reconciliation processes, controls, and reporting requirements are established prior to launch.
Participate in discussions with internal stakeholders and external partners to resolve financial and operational issues affecting reconciliation and settlement activities.

Regulatory Compliance & Audit Support

Prepare and maintain reconciliation schedules, supporting documentation, and account analyses required for internal reviews, external audits, and regulatory reporting requirements related to accounts under the role's responsibility.
